lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of approximately 15-20 visible high-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, spanning from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a highlight on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are primarily concentrated on the posterior half and basal region of the first dorsal fin silhouette, with a lower density of smaller, less-defined spots near the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin; presence of two elongated, low-luminance appendages (likely remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex labyrinthine or vermiculated high-intensity pixel patterns localized on the dorsal-lateral region of the head and surrounding the five branchial slits.
